simple.meaning: רִאשָׁה (riʼshâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a beginning.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רִאשָׁה (H7221) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רִאשָׁה (H7221) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רִאשָׁה (riʼshâh) / H7221 is traced through Ezekiel 36:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
